parameters.name: organizationId
parameters.description: Organization identifier, also known as organization ID, in string format. It can be obtained from the Alibaba Cloud DevOps access link, for example: https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】

parameters.name: spaceIdentifier
parameters.description: UUID of the project, equivalent to projectId

parameters.name: workitemTypeIdentifier
parameters.description: Work item type ID. The list of work item types and their IDs can be retrieved from ListProjectWorkitemTypes.
